title: Ignition Failure / No Flame
shortDescription: Greenstar boiler failed to detect flame after ignition retries.
fullDescription:
EA (sometimes shown as 227) is the Worcester Bosch Greenstar ignition lockout. The boiler attempts ignition three times and then locks out if flame is not detected.

Common causes: closed gas valve, fouled flame rod, low gas supply pressure, plugged condensate trap with frozen condensate in cold weather.
safetyWarning: If you smell gas, evacuate and call 0800 111 999.

fixSteps.title: Thaw condensate pipe
fixSteps.instruction: If condensate pipe runs outside, thaw with warm cloth (NOT boiling water).

whenToCallPro: Gas Safe engineer for gas pressure work.

faq.a: Yes — first cold snap in October/November is the peak season for EA.

title: Overheat / High Limit
shortDescription: Heat exchanger exceeded the safety thermostat trip point.
fullDescription:
E9 indicates the Greenstar safety thermostat opened. Causes are loss of flow (failed pump, closed isolation, air-bound HX) or heat exchanger fouled with limescale.

In hard-water areas E9 is often the precursor to a HX replacement; an annual service with limescale inhibitor is recommended.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass the safety thermostat.

fixSteps.title: Verify isolation
fixSteps.instruction: Check both flow and return service valves are open.

fixSteps.title: Bleed radiators
fixSteps.instruction: Bleed all radiators and the system.

faq.a: Fit a magnetic filter and use a chemical inhibitor.

title: Fan Fault
shortDescription: Combustion fan stopped running during a heat call.
fullDescription: C1 indicates the fan stopped or did not reach the required speed. Common on older Greenstars where the fan motor brushes wear out.
safetyWarning: Mains isolation required before fan work.
symptoms: No fan sound or weak fan

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat fan PWM and tach connectors.

fixSteps.title: Schedule replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Gas Safe engineer to swap fan.

title: Return Sensor Fault
fullDescription: D1 covers the inlet/return sensor on Greenstar. The boiler will not fire without it.
safetyWarning: Power off before sensor work.

title: DHW Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Domestic hot water sensor out of range.
fullDescription: A7 covers the DHW NTC. Heating will continue but DHW will be unreliable.
safetyWarning: Power off before sensor work.

title: Internal Control Fault
fullDescription: E1 is a generic Worcester Bosch PCB fault. A single occurrence may clear with a power cycle; repeat E1 needs PCB replacement.
safetyWarning: Mains isolation before opening cabinet.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Off at the spur for 2 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Schedule service
fixSteps.instruction: Gas Safe engineer for PCB swap.

title: Internal Communication Error
fullDescription: F0 indicates a communication fault between PCB and display, or between safety chips. Power cycle clears most cases.
safetyWarning: Mains isolation before any work.

title: Flame Signal Persists
fullDescription: F7 indicates the control sees a flame signal when the gas valve is closed. Treat as a possible stuck gas valve or moisture on ignition assembly.
safetyWarning: Treat as gas-valve safety event.

faq.a: Damp basement installs are at higher risk.

title: Low Pressure
fullDescription:
H07 is the Greenstar low-pressure warning. Top up via the filling key or external loop to 1.0-1.5 bar cold.

Unlike F.22 on Vaillant, H07 is a warning rather than full lockout on some Greenstar models — boiler may still run briefly.
safetyWarning: Do not exceed 2 bar.

fixSteps.title: Top up
fixSteps.instruction: Use filling key to bring pressure to 1.2 bar.

title: No Flame Detected (Numeric)
shortDescription: Newer Greenstar models show 227 instead of EA for ignition lockout.
fullDescription:
227 is the numeric equivalent of EA on later Greenstar firmware. Same root causes — closed gas, frozen condensate, fouled ignition rod, low gas pressure.

Reset via the long-press of the reset button. Three failed attempts within an hour locks out the boiler for ~24 minutes before allowing reset.
safetyWarning: If gas odor present, evacuate and call 0800 111 999.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold reset button until display clears.

faq.a: Newer firmware uses numeric codes; functionally identical.

title: Internal fault
fullDescription: Internal control fault. Common boiler fault on Worcester Bosch models. Resolve following manufacturer service procedure.
safetyWarning: Gas appliance — turn off gas supply and disconnect power before servicing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor/flow
fixSteps.instruction: Check sensor wiring and water flow.

whenToCallPro: Gas-appliance work usually requires Gas Safe (UK) or licensed plumber (US/CA).

faq.a: Don't use if gas leak suspected — call gas emergency.
